mapper.sql: SELECT br.id, br.user_id AS userId, br.book_id AS bookId, br.borrow_time AS borrowTime, br.due_time AS dueTime, br.return_time AS returnTime, br.status, br.renew_count AS renewCount, CASE WHEN br.status = 'BORROWING' AND br.due_time < NOW() THEN GREATEST(DATEDIFF(DATE(NOW()), DATE(br.due_time)), 1) ELSE br.overdue_days END AS overdueDays, CASE WHEN br.status = 'RETURNED' THEN br.fine_amount WHEN br.status = 'BORROWING' AND br.due_time < NOW() THEN GREATEST(DATEDIFF(DATE(NOW()), DATE(br.due_time)), 1) * IFNULL((SELECT CAST(config_value AS DECIMAL(10, 2)) FROM system_config WHERE config_key = 'fine_per_day' LIMIT 1), 0.5) ELSE 0 END AS fineAmount, u.username, u.nickname, b.title AS bookTitle, b.author AS bookAuthor, c.name AS categoryName, CASE WHEN br.status = 'BORROWING' AND br.due_time < NOW() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS overdue, DATEDIFF(br.due_time, NOW()) AS remainDays FROM borrow_record br INNER JOIN user u ON br.user_id = u.id INNER JOIN book b ON br.book_id = b.id LEFT JOIN category c ON b.category_id = c.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO borrow_record (user_id, book_id, borrow_time, due_time, status, renew_count, overdue_days, fine_amount) VALUES (#{userId}, #{bookId}, #{borrowTime}, #{dueTime}, #{status}, #{renewCount}, 0, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM borrow_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'BORROWING'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM borrow_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND book_id = #{bookId} AND status = 'BORROWING'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM borrow_record WHERE book_id = #{bookId}
mapper.update: UPDATE borrow_record SET due_time = #{dueTime}, renew_count = renew_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'BORROWING'
UPDATE borrow_record SET status = 'RETURNED', return_time = #{returnTime}, overdue_days = #{overdueDays}, fine_amount = #{fineAmount} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'BORROWING'
mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM book) AS totalBooks, (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(stock), 0) FROM book) AS totalStock, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM borrow_record WHERE status = 'BORROWING') AS borrowingCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM borrow_record WHERE status = 'BORROWING' AND due_time < NOW()) AS overdueCount, (SELECT IFNULL(SUM( CASE WHEN status = 'RETURNED' THEN fine_amount WHEN status = 'BORROWING' AND due_time < NOW() THEN GREATEST(DATEDIFF(DATE(NOW()), DATE(due_time)), 1) * IFNULL((SELECT CAST(config_value AS DECIMAL(10, 2)) FROM system_config WHERE config_key = 'fine_per_day' LIMIT 1), 0.5) ELSE 0 END ), 0) FROM borrow_record) AS totalFine, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user WHERE role = 'USER') AS userCount

SELECT c.name AS categoryName, COUNT(br.id) AS borrowCount, SUM(CASE WHEN br.status = 'BORROWING' AND br.due_time < NOW() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS overdueCount FROM category c LEFT JOIN book b ON c.id = b.category_id LEFT JOIN borrow_record br ON b.id = br.book_id GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY borrowCount DESC

SELECT b.id AS bookId, b.title AS bookTitle, c.name AS categoryName, COUNT(br.id) AS borrowCount FROM book b LEFT JOIN category c ON b.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN borrow_record br ON b.id = br.book_id GROUP BY b.id, b.title, c.name ORDER BY borrowCount DESC LIMIT #{limit}
